Ground force and work balance

Supported experiment

Planar spring-supported ring with distributed mass and native MuJoCo edge contacts. Numerical contact overlap is bounded; rim contact, excessive deformation, self-crossing and unresolved motion stop the run at the last accepted state.

Casing resolution still affects sharp-corner results. This is not a calibrated inflated tyre or a converged stress model. No traction, pressure evolution, fracture, articulated rider or full-bike trail motion is simulated here. The shared wheel assembly is the next contact input to the bicycle model.

Edit terrain, ring properties, limits and provenance

Full experiment JSON in SI. Profile points retain square edges; terrain and tyre refinement are separate. Assembly declarations use the wheel-limit schema. Supplied limits do not establish tyre survival; missing evidence stays unknown.
